units: Literal integer token base units, not whole AGIALPHA tokens
formula: eachGross = floor(p/40); workerGross = p - 2*eachGross; recipientBurn = floor(recipientGross/100); recipientNet = recipientGross - recipientBurn
criteria: All nine arithmetic vectors must match independent BigInt arithmetic, with per-recipient flooring.

For p below100, actual source must reject post with job bounds and reject bid with bid bounds on a separate valid bounty100 job; token balances, supply, escrow, stake and lock state must remain unchanged across each rejection. These are not settlement receipts.

For p at least100, use unchanged fixture and production-equivalent source, post price=bounty=p, bid, award, deliver, and approve using distinct local actors. Two affirmative validators qualify, third abstains.

Check worker and each validator balance deltas separately, third validator unchanged, total supply decrease, market escrow conservation, no surplus refund, worker collateral unlock, and exactly three Payout events matching per-recipient gross and burn.
Keep every attempted case including failures. Run only this added file with --no-compile after existing38 tests and unchanged demo.
scope: Independent local integer-boundary test of the existing production-equivalent Alpha five-suite source. Simulated tokens, mock ENS and admission, local actors. No live provider, signing credentials, financial authority, physical qualification, independent organizational review, or thermal harness acceptance.
